assumptions.statement: The official SITE_BOUNDARY polygon has not been released. The spatial base is brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson, carried throughout as official_boundary=false, geometry_role=provisional_constraint, boundary_precision=provisional_rough.
assumptions.impact: The recomputed design area of 11,412,825.386 sqm deviates from the announced 11,400,000 sqm by 0.1125%. That deviation quantifies provisional precision and is not a correction of the announcement. Once the official polygon is released, site boundary, key areas, land use, roads, green space, public space, buildings, phasing and every metric must be recomputed as a whole rather than patched file by file.

assumptions.statement: The three official KEY_AREA polygons have not been released. Key-area geometry is derived from the same provisional boundary file and is labelled provisional throughout.
assumptions.impact: The three areas recompute to 369.3 ha in total against the announced 368.4 ha, and per-area values (Dazhongsi 72.05 vs 72.0, AI Origin Community 104.32 vs 104.3, Zhongzhiyuan 192.92 vs 192.1) are cross-checks rather than precise-area claims. Frontage relationships and scenario placement inside the key areas are concept suggestions at this precision.

assumptions.statement: No official control conditions were supplied with the site package for floor area ratio, building height, building density or setbacks, and brief/site-package/ranges/planning_limits.json records them as not provided.
assumptions.impact: total_floor_area_sqm, floor_area_ratio, building_height_m, official_green_ratio_control, official_building_density_control and official_setback_m are registered in metrics.json as status: unknown, never replaced by estimates. Building scale in this package is limited to illustrative footprints (226,800 sqm, 1.99% of the design area) which do not constitute a development-scale conclusion. Approved regulatory conditions or official brief attachments are required to resolve them.

assumptions.statement: No official green-ratio or public-space control value was supplied, so the recomputed green ratio of 33.97% and public-space share of 9.97% are outcomes of the design rather than responses to a statutory figure.
assumptions.impact: Both must be rechecked once official control values are released. They may not be cited as compliance with any statutory green-space requirement.

assumptions.statement: Ownership, building condition and resident-consent material for parcels inside the belt is not held by this proposal.
assumptions.impact: The retain-renovate-demolish strategy reaches no parcel-level conclusion and offers only judgement principles ordered by priority: retain the heritage corridor's linear continuity, renovate east-line ground-floor frontages, defer anything involving complex ownership, relocation or ongoing firm operation. Parcel-level judgements belong to professional teams and the competent authorities.

assumptions.statement: Rail alignment, road alignment, bridge and tunnel works, utility networks, underground engineering feasibility, energy load and municipal capacity require professional calculation on official data that this package does not hold.
assumptions.impact: The transport and municipal chapter offers only structural and interchange principles as concept suggestions: spine continuity, all east-west vehicular movement on the five stitch streets, coordination of stitch-street positions with walkable catchments of existing rail stations, and compute and data infrastructure recognised as industrial infrastructure with expandable locations reserved. No engineering scheme conclusion is drawn.

assumptions.statement: All ten scenario cards and the three industry test scenarios are concept suggestions built only on public data, with no named supplier as a precondition.
assumptions.impact: A test scenario is not approved operation. Extent, hours, safe distances and opening arrangements require professional assessment; anything touching public safety or ethical compliance requires human review and authorisation from the competent authority. No facial recognition or individual tracking is used in any scenario, and each provides a non-participating alternative.

assumptions.statement: The three-stage phasing covering 561.5 ha, opening from the reversal point outwards, is a discussion proposal.
assumptions.impact: It constitutes neither a development sequence, an investment arrangement, an approval schedule nor a government commitment. Sequencing rationale is structural: the reversal point is the link both legs depend on, so building it first lets every later segment attach to an existing structure.
